contract.image_selection: Complete checksummed atomic publication stays inactive until a synchronized Install receipt selects exact generation/identity/base/full Descriptor.
contract.replay_equivalence: Canonical opaque full prefix plus checked suffix reproduces actual committed records, selected image, term/vote and commit; replay independently recomputes receipt outcome from loaded image and preceding WAL.
contract.foreign_and_incomplete: Incomplete transfer, foreign cluster/topic/partition/voters, same-term changed content, changed committed bytes, forged Descriptor/receipts and selected image corruption reject.

contract.interruption: Recover old selected image and later committed suffix through image sync/rename/directory-sync cuts; replay new selection through after Install/before Core and after Core/before ACK cuts.

limitations: Finite process/IO faults and checksum-valid mutation tests do not establish physical power-loss/hardware behavior.

Custom local PLSNAP image and PLREPL Install receipt preserve opaque full prefix metadata content; they are not native Kafka FetchSnapshot payloads, an application-state fold or physical log compaction.

Replication/snapshot transfer is caller-driven typed exchange with trusted configured fixed voters and paths; no autonomous outbound runtime, authenticated peer protocol or dynamic quorum transition is qualified.

The complete 1216 test count covers the whole broker crate, not 1,216 snapshot-specific assertions. Root primary/cut state counts overlap where independently checked; do not add them as independent scenario totals.
Apache component evidence concerns snapshot offsets/epochs/completion and publication primitives; customformat and durable causal installation rely on separate Rust runtime/raw WAL/image proof.
Partial/superseded source gates remain explicitly incomplete. Shared finalQA did not consume unrelated WORK source.
